links.outcome: Differential diagnosis accuracy of AI agent versus independent clinicians given the same dialogue
links.effect: SymptomAI DDx were significantly more accurate than independent clinicians (OR = 2.56, p < 0.001) in a blinded randomized comparison.
links.quote: SymptomAI DDx were significantly more accurate (OR = 2.56, p < 0.001) than those from independent clinicians given the same dialogue in a blinded randomized comparison.

unlisted_practices: Dedicated structured symptom interview by agentic AI before diagnosis compared with user-guided conversation (p < 0.001)

screen.reason: Empirical study deploying conversational AI agents in the Fitbit app with real participants, testing structured elicitation vs standard user-guided conversation.

primary.practice: structured symptom interview agent strategy vs user-guided dialogue
